title: Peptide Vial Barcodes on Curved Glass: Choose Orientation by Scan Test
seoTitle: Peptide Vial Barcode Orientation on Curved Glass | RP
description: Plan barcode orientation on a small peptide vial from the actual scanner, glass diameter and applied-label proof, not a flat artwork preview alone.
alt: AI-generated branded research vials comparing vertical and horizontal example barcodes on curved glass beside a scanner
caption: AI-generated orientation comparison, not a verified RP scan test. Barcode patterns, brand variant and lot marks are illustrative DEMO artwork.
intro: A barcode can look flawless in a PDF and still disappear around the side of a small vial when a scanner approaches it.
sources: GS1 General Specifications: curved-surface symbol placement

title: Peptide Vial DataMatrix or QR Code? Start With the Scanner
seoTitle: Peptide Vial DataMatrix vs QR Code | Scan Workflow Guide
description: Compare DataMatrix and QR artwork for small research vial labels by scanner, encoded data, destination and applied-label testing before ordering.
alt: AI-generated RP Research vial proofs showing illustrative DataMatrix-style and QR-style code panels beside a scanner and phone
caption: AI-generated code-layout demonstration. The pictured code shapes are not validated, assigned GS1 identifiers or working authentication links.
intro: The smaller-looking square is not automatically the right code. The first question is who must scan the vial and what their device should do.
sources: GS1: differences among GS1 DataMatrix and GS1 Digital Link QR

title: Supplement Label Ingredients and Allergen Copy: Reserve the Right Panel Space
seoTitle: Supplement Label Ingredients and Allergen Panel | RP
description: Reserve space for the ingredient statement and brand-reviewed allergen copy on a custom supplement bottle label before approving the dieline.
alt: AI-generated branded supplement bottle and full-color proof with Supplement Facts and Other Ingredients area marked for allergen-copy review
caption: AI-generated prepress layout, not an approved supplement formula or compliant finished label. Ingredient and allergen text requires review by the brand's qualified team.
intro: The side panel is often treated as leftover space. For a supplement label, it is the space you need to protect first.
sources: FDA Dietary Supplement Labeling Guide, Chapter I: required statements and panel placement
FDA Dietary Supplement Labeling Guide, Chapter V: ingredient statement
FDA food allergen labeling Q&A, including dietary supplements

title: Supplement Bottle Labels: Who Goes on the Business Name and Address Line?
seoTitle: Supplement Label Business Name and Address Layout | RP
description: Set the manufacturer, packer or distributor business line on a supplement bottle label after the brand confirms its legal copy and information panel.
alt: AI-generated RP Wellness bottle and branded label proof with the business-information line flagged for approval
caption: AI-generated artwork review scene. Business names and layout are fictional examples; the responsible brand must supply and approve its actual business information.
intro: A printer can place a supplied business line accurately. It should not guess which company is legally responsible for the bottle.
sources: FDA Dietary Supplement Labeling Guide, Chapter I: name and place of business
FDA Dietary Supplement Labeling Guide, Chapter V: information-panel ingredients

title: Hologram Seals for Folding Cartons: Design the Perforation Around the Opening
seoTitle: Hologram Carton Seal Perforation and Tear Path | RP

caption: AI-generated carton-opening concept, not a tamper-evidence test or claim that this construction meets any security standard. Verify on the real carton.
